data.acceptance:
- `kno push` succeeds while a local lease is active.
- `kno sync` with an active lease publishes local events and reports the pull
  half as deferred, rather than deferring both halves.
- `SyncOutcome::Deferred` carries the push summary; JSON consumers can see what
  was published.
- `kno pull` still refuses while an active lease exists (unchanged until the
  per-knot filter lands).
- docs/leases.md no longer claims push is blocked by leases.
- The MCP background sync loop logs a deferral that distinguishes "pushed, pull
  deferred" from "nothing happened".
